meta.description: Reconstructs single-cell lineage trees and clonal relationships from CRISPR/Cas9 scars, static expressed barcodes, or somatic mtDNA mutations using Cassiopeia, Startle, and CoSpar.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations, results, or quantitative claims were emitted in the seven audit outputs.

practice_boundaries.detail: Input 7 declined a diagnostic or treatment conclusion and directed the request to qualified clinical review, as the current Common Errors table requires.

methodological_ground.detail: The executed workflows preserve missing versus unedited scar states, distinguish clonal grouping from deep phylogeny, and retain solver-robustness caveats.

code_usability.detail: Current source-faithful tree, CoSpar, mtDNA, and Startle routes executed in their required separate environments; raw-read APIs were introspected because no raw-read fixture was supplied.

functional_suitability.note: Covers scar trees, solver comparison, clone-state integration, mtDNA grouping, and homoplasy refinement; raw-read conversion has no shipped regression fixture.

reliability.note: The separate-environment, Gurobi, embedding, and cache-collision failures are explicitly documented, though the raw-read route remains live-untested.

performance_context.note: The 228-line Skill uses progressive sections and separates incompatible environments without unnecessary repetition.

agent_usability.note: Clear decision tables, expected failure signatures, and direct runnable patterns guide an agent through distinct tracing assays.

human_usability.note: The usage guide is concise and points users to the detailed Skill sections rather than duplicating them.

security.note: No credential, injection, destructive-operation, or sensitive-data leakage pattern was found; mtDNA privacy and clinical-boundary notes are explicit.

maintainability.note: Concrete version anchors and examples support maintenance, but a small raw-read fixture and automated smoke suite are absent.

agent_specific.note: Trigger description, decision tables, escape hatches, and scope refusal are strong; the licensed solver comment still requires agent attention before literal execution.

recommendations.title: Add a small raw-read regression fixture
recommendations.problem: The raw-read-to-character-matrix path was verified by live API signature but not exercised end to end because no compact fixture is supplied.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill provides a code pattern but no testable molecule/read fixture.
recommendations.fix: Add a tiny synthetic molecule table and barcode reference plus an invocation that asserts a nonempty character matrix and priors.

recommendations.title: Show a nontrivial Startle improvement fixture
recommendations.problem: The fresh simple matrix completed Startle but had zero weighted parsimony, so it proves CLI compatibility rather than topology improvement.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill describes the expected improvement without bundling a compact homoplasy fixture.
recommendations.fix: Provide or reference a small scar matrix with nonzero seed score and assert that refined_info.json reports an equal-or-lower score.
